name: JMK
description:
JMK and CAT can do some real Dmg, and work on manual across all phases, if you stick primarily to LS missions.
The comp is pretty locked. You have to take out the opposing tank with CAT, and then use the momentum to stay alive. Save CAT's second 1-shot for wave 2 and put Dmg immunity on GK. Try to reset all CDs before wave 2 as well.
notes: Very little flexibility, but no Omi
Must line up and execute abilities in a certain way
